meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
I didn't come for thanks, Hale. Who entered that zero, and had anyone spoken to Owen before it went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still expect the zero on Owen's essay withdrawn, an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and an explanation of who decided it and on what basis. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF

Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and a meeting with the principal; the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, was never reached because the meeting ended after two exchanges, well before her time ran out.
What moved her: Nothing, because no evidence or ownership of the process was offered.
What cost ground: Hale answered her direct question about who entered the zero with a pleasantry, which told her Hale was avoiding the procedural failure she came to fight about.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; Hale's evidence never came near that night because no evidence was presented; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she first asked who decided and when, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put a dated document about Owen's own work in front of her.
